imageDisclosure: Photography on this site is editorial illustration, not the reviewed units.
disclosureNote: Two statements, deliberately. Both appear above the fold on every page and again in the footer.

searchConsoleNote: Google Search Console verification token. Empty by design: the meta tag is emitted only when this is set (SG-29). Verifying the property is an owner step with a signed-in Google account (FLG-013, Q-12).
readerCaptureNote: Reader email capture (SG-30) ships only when this is set to a form endpoint the owner controls. Until then the front page advertises RSS alone, per suggestion S-06. Update the privacy notice before enabling.
